sourceContract: Cursor agent hook `preToolUse` carrying an MCP-encoded tool name (mcp__<server>__<tool>), per cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks
author: otel-hook cursor provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Real key set, synthetic values. The MCP server, tool, and query are invented; no real MCP server or issue tracker is referenced.
licenseBasis: Original authorship; only the field names and their types are taken from the published reference and the cited capture set.
notes: The empty `cwd` is not an oversight: the CLI captures in colinsurprenant/director hack/canary/cursor-cli/findings report cwd as "" for a workspace-rooted call, which is why the schema does not require a non-empty string. `tool_use_id` follows the IDE capture's `tool_<hex>` spelling. Parity confirmation, not a divergence: both opentelemetry-hooks and our comparison mapper split mcp__<server>__<tool> into separate server/tool fields.
